[[File:SelkathWriting-SWTOR.png|thumb|Selkath's writing system, as seen in the ruins of the [[Ancient Selkath City]].]]
'''Selkath''', also known as '''Selkatha''', was the language of the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]]. It was also one language spoken by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Rakatan guardian droid|guardian droid]] that [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] encountered while searching for the [[Star Map]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Non-native speakers included [[Dreddon]], [[Bastila Shan]] and Revan himself.

When Revan and Bastila Shan entered the temple containing the Star Map, the Rakatan guardian droid cycled through the languages it was programmed with until both [[Jedi]] recognized and understood an ancient form of Selkatha. After this, it communicated with them in the language.
